title: Hearty Malty Korean Pecan Kalguksu
description: A malty, shattering, weeknight Korean dish featuring pecan nuts and pasta-water-emulsion, this kosher-friendly kalguksu is perfect for a quick dinner
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the kalguksu noodles according to the package instructions
In a blender or food processor, blend the chopped pecan nuts, malted milk powder, and 1/4 cup of water until a smooth emulsion forms
In a large skillet, heat the sesame oil over medium heat and saute the minced garlic and grated ginger until fragrant
Add the cooked noodles to the skillet and stir to combine with the garlic and ginger
Add the soy sauce and pecan emulsion to the skillet and stir to combine
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the sauce has thickened slightly
Stir in the chopped green onions and cook for an additional minute
Serve the kalguksu hot, garnished with additional chopped pecans and green onions if desired
